title: Keep synthetic planning regressions independent of evolving repository graph
api_or_output: Stable synthetic negative graph scenarios plus live repository validation

acceptance.description: Replace brittle live-graph assumptions with explicit isolated synthetic scenarios proving missing gate reachability, unordered case-insensitive path overlap, and independent bootstrap lanes; preserve all negative guarantees and live repository graph test. Do not relax tracker validation or remove failing test coverage.

Run all planning regression tests and tasks.py validate at known revision; prove each intended invalid mutation actually fails validation and readiness scenarios remain independent of new task splits/repairs.

handoff.summary: Namespace repair checks exposed three stale synthetic scenarios after earlier graph/task ownership changes; root reproduced 11 passed/3 failed at main1493e5c. Product checks unaffected.
